run_outer_loop_aft: run the Annealed Flow Transport Monte Carlo outer loop with a flow, density, and config
run_inner_loop: run the AFT inner loop to optimize free energy and update samples and log weights
optimize_free_energy: optimize an estimate of the free energy using optax gradients and a stopping criterion
get_initial_samples: get initial train validation and test samples and log weights from an initial sampler
update_tuples: update sample tuples and log weights using a flow and Markov kernel for a given step
